det.awp.name: AWP kill
det.blind.desc: Kill with attackerblind=true (the shooter was flashed).
det.blind.name: Blind kill
det.clutch.desc: 1vN won: the player became the last one alive on the team with N enemies alive (entity state when the teammate died) and the team won the round. If the clutcher dies and the bomb explodes afterwards, it still counts as a round win.
det.clutch.name: Clutch
det.damage.desc: Health damage to enemies in the round above the threshold (default 300), capped at each victim's remaining health.
det.damage.name: High damage
det.defuse.desc: The player's defuse with enemies still alive (ninja / under pressure), with less than N seconds on the bomb timer (default 3 s, 40 s timer) or as the last CT alive.
det.defuse.name: Clutch defuse
det.firstblood.desc: The round's first enemy kill was made by the player.
det.firstblood.name: First Blood
det.headshot.desc: Kill with headshot=true in the player_death event.
det.headshot.name: Headshot
det.kill.desc: Every enemy kill (player_death event). Team kills and suicides are ignored.
det.kill.name: Kill
det.knife.desc: The player_death weapon is a knife (knife*/bayonet).
det.knife.name: Knife kill
det.multikill.desc: 2, 3, 4 or 5+ enemy kills in the same round (Double, Triple, Quad, Ace).
det.multikill.name: Multi-kill
det.noscope.desc: Kill with noscope=true in player_death (set by the game itself; only with scoped weapons).
det.noscope.name: No-scope
det.quick.desc: 2+ kills with a configurable maximum gap between them (default 1.5 s).
det.quick.name: Quick kills
det.retake.desc: A CT player killed at least one T after the plant and the CTs won the round (defuse or time).
det.retake.name: Retake
det.round.desc: Round that won the match or saved an opponent's match point, won by the player's team with the player's participation (kill, plant or defuse). MR12 rules with MR3 overtime; uses the demo's mp_maxrounds when available.
det.round.name: Decisive round
det.smoke.name: Through smoke
det.streak.desc: N+ kills (default 3) within a time window (default 10 s).
det.streak.name: Kill streak
det.utility.desc: One HE (0.5 s window) or molotov/incendiary (7 s window) dealt damage above the threshold (default 80).
det.utility.name: Utility damage
det.wallbang.desc: Kill with penetrated>0 in player_death (the bullet went through at least one surface). Limitation: the game does not tell walls from thin objects; both count.
det.wallbang.name: Wallbang
det.zeus.desc: The player_death weapon is taser (Zeus x27).
det.zeus.name: Zeus kill

home.clipboardNoCode: The clipboard does not contain a CS2 share code.
home.dropText: Counter-Strike 2 .dem and .dem.bz2 files (MM, Premier, FACEIT, Gamers Club, HLTV...). The analysis reads the demo data without opening the game.
home.how1: 1. The demo is read directly (without opening the game): kills, damage, bomb, grenades, positions and rounds.
home.how2: 2. Detectors score aces, clutches, multi-kills, no-scopes, wallbangs and more.
home.how3: 3. To make the video, the app opens CS2, jumps to the exact tick, locks the POV and records the window in real time (Windows Graphics Capture + FFmpeg).
home.localNotOnDisk: Demo not on disk — it will be downloaded with the code
home.shareCodeHint: Paste the match code (CS2 → Watch → Your Matches). Ctrl+V on any screen works too.
home.shareCodeInvalid: Paste a code in the format CSGO-xxxxx-xxxxx-xxxxx-xxxxx-xxxxx (CS2 → Watch → Your Matches → copy code).
home.subtitle: Import a CS2 demo (.dem or .dem.bz2) or paste the match share code, pick the player and turn the best moments into MP4 videos.
home.title: Home
queue.dupRendered: Already rendered with the same settings
queue.hint: While recording, CS2 stays in the foreground and plays the demo in real time; avoid using the mouse/keyboard. Pausing stops the current segment — segments already recorded are kept and rendering resumes where it stopped.
queue.remove: Remove from the list (the video is kept)
queue.restartCs2Text:
CS2 is open but was not started by this app, so it can't be controlled.

Close CS2 now so the app can reopen it in render mode?
(Your video settings and binds are saved and restored at the end.)
render.buildingMaster: Assembling the clip (cuts and audio sync)
render.noSegments: The highlight has no segments to record.
settings.aboutText: cs2clutchEz is free and open source (MIT license). Not affiliated with Valve.
settings.cleanupBinds: Remove the helper bind (F13) when finished
settings.closeGame: Close CS2 when the queue finishes (restores video settings and binds)
settings.cs2Hint: The app opens CS2 in a borderless window at the capture resolution, with -condebug and +exec cs2hg/boot, and controls the demo through a .cfg run with the F13 key. Nothing is injected into the game. Your video settings, convars and binds are saved before and restored afterwards.
settings.ffmpegHint: Requires FFmpeg 8.1+ (gfxcapture filter). The installer already ships FFmpeg 9.
settings.languageHint: Applies immediately. Titles of highlights already analyzed stay in the language of that analysis.
settings.nothingToRestore: Nothing to restore (or CS2 is open — close it first).
settings.rootFolder: Main folder (Demos, Highlights, Thumbnails, Logs, Database)
settings.savedRestart: Settings saved. Restart the app to use the new main folder.
settings.subtitle: Language, folders, CS2, FFmpeg and detection.
